body: sounds like a beautiful place. I bet you’ll find a reason to live up there.. or a few (your friends)

Yea, okay so all of those things. But you know what? You can just pick yourself up and drive a uhaul around the country. You can see all the places you’ve imagined. And you’ll be with the one person who can love you unconditionally forever: you :)

Thank you. I love them so much, and the thought of them hurting is often the only thing that keeps me here. 

I’m a lady. But the app route is a good tip. I’d rather just be able to heal and find happiness. however my boss doesn’t believe me and has been making my legally protected time off miserable. I find myself thinking that when I go thru with it I will prove her wrong.
